content.text: In this video on "Introduction to Artificial Intelligence | Artificial Intelligence Explained | The Knowledge Academy," we dive into the fascinating world of AI. We will explore what artificial intelligence is, its various applications, and how it is transforming industries. Whether you're a beginner looking to understand AI or a professional wanting to deepen your knowledge, this tutorial is designed to provide you with a comprehensive overview of artificial intelligence and its key concepts. What is Artificial Intelligence? Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems. In this section, we will explain the fundamentals of AI, including its history, the different types of AI (narrow AI, general AI, and super AI), and the basic principles that guide AI systems. Understanding these concepts will give you a solid foundation in AI and its potential impact on the future. How is Artificial Intelligence transforming industries? Artificial Intelligence is revolutionising various industries by enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making processes. This tutorial will discuss real-world applications of AI in sectors such as healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and customer service.
